ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels localized primarily at the outer lateral tips and in scattered focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black region across the central and lower fluke. High-contrast white mottling and dense pixel clusters are mapped to the superior-lateral margins of both lobes. Scattered high-intensity circular dots are visible across the central-mid region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a clearly defined vertex and an estimated pixel angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge. The left lobe exhibits approximately 5-6 major peak variations, while the right lobe displays a more jagged, higher-frequency serration pattern leading to the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a convex trajectory from the base, transitioning into a concave taper toward the median notch and a convex sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle scars) are densely concentrated on the superior edge of the left lobe and scattered across the central-medial black pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions are visible diagonally across the medial-lower portion of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological accumulation (stalked barnacles) is visible protruding from the distal tip of the right lobe and along the superior-lateral edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip exhibits a highly unique, non-uniform silhouette due to a dense cluster of protruding organismal growth.
